conditions: No new real observation is supplied inside candidate rollouts.
Only the first selected action is actually executed; remaining predicted transitions are not real records.
The three displayed candidates and four action slots per candidate are schematic, not algorithmic fixed counts.
The learned model may be deterministic/task oriented; this diagram does not claim full-observation reconstruction or exact latent MDP equivalence.
This drawing uses the original deterministic prior interface g_theta; TD-MPC2's stochastic entropy-regularized prior is a separate textual extension.
The execution interface allows return-weighted or elite-updated sequence optimization; it is not restricted to argmax over one sampled sequence.
